Gifted: Creation.name: Gifted: Creation
Gifted: Creation.description:
🧬 Creation, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you pull simple things of one or two materials from your palms and arms: a staff, a baton, a rope, a shield you can crouch behind.
📈 With training: tangling bolas, field medical supplies, a spring grapple, a steel dome, sleeping-gas canisters, a ring of cannons and, at the top, whole working machines.
⚠️ You can only make what you have studied.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, since every object costs what you have eaten.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Momo Yaoyorozu (Creation).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Creation.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Creation family): Scale: the user makes solid, nonliving objects that push out through the skin, built from stored body fat. A new adult user makes a simple one- or two-material object, baton to crouch-behind shield, in a second or two; a key or spring takes a quiet minute. Objects are real and stay. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only what the user has studied down to its materials; a guess comes out brittle or fails. At the start, nothing alive, at a distance or bigger than the user. A dozen batons leave a new user hungry and shaky; made food never repays its cost; enemies can take made things. Quirk Strain: light: handheld tool or weapon; moderate: shield, bolas, medical supplies, grapple; heavy: shelter dome, gas canister; severe: signature move, large machine. Type: Emitter. Law: a made blade or gun is still a weapon; a made ID or banknote is forgery.
